_comment: Companions that DECLARE a nodus-lang dependency, with the local checkout.
One list, read by two gates that each used to keep their own (#810):
tools/check_dependent_suites.py   -- Gate 10a, runs each suite pre-publish
They disagreed. Gate 10a had 6 names, Stage 6 had 7, and the true set is 8:
nodus-workflow-ai was missing from the first and nodus-a2a-wire from both, so
a published first-party dependent had neither its suite run before an upload
nor its range checked after one.
The criterion is DECLARES, not imports. That distinction is the other half of
#810: nodus-workflow-ai imports nothing from nodus-lang -- it *emits* Nodus
source -- and a generator can be broken without importing anything. The syntax
it emits stops parsing, or a CLI flag it passes is refused, which is #791's
exact shape and shipped in 5.12.0. A registry keyed on imports cannot see it.
`published` says whether the name resolves on PyPI. An unpublished dependent
still has its suite run; it is only the range check that has nothing to fetch.
Register on the day the package is written, not the day it ships.
tools/check_publish_drift.py keeps a separate and LARGER list on purpose --
every published companion, not only the ones depending on nodus-lang. The
containment is checked by tests/test_dependent_registry.py rather than assumed.

nodus-workflow-ai.note: #93. Declares nodus-lang>=5.8.0 and imports nothing from it -- it emits Nodus source. Missing from Gate 10a until #810; its suite was run by hand at the 5.12.0 cut and passed.

nodus-a2a-wire.note: #477. Missing from BOTH registries until #810. The checkout is a2a-wire-pub; the worktree once named nodus-a2a-wire was the coordinator's old history and was removed 2026-09-07. IMPORTANT: its nodus-lang link is a DEV EXTRA, not a runtime dependency -- published metadata is 'nodus-lang>=4.0.0; extra == "dev"' and its `dependencies` list is empty, because the only import is one test that skips without it. Do not remove this entry on the grounds that the runtime deps are empty: Gate 10a runs suites, that suite imports nodus-lang under PYTHONPATH=src, and a nodus-lang change can turn it red. It is a canary, not a component.

_ignored_comment: Checkouts beside the registered ones that declare nodus-lang and are NOT
first-party companions of this repo. The sweep in nodus_lang_dependents.py
reports anything it finds that is neither registered above nor named here,
so a new dependent shows up rather than being silently absent -- which is
how nodus-a2a-wire stayed out of both gates.
Every entry states a reason, the way tools/shape_manifest.json and
tools/dependent_flakes.json do. Silence is what this file exists to remove.
This repo excludes itself by path; it needs no entry.
